Technology executive with more than 25 years of experience leading engineering organizations,
modernizing enterprise platforms, and improving delivery performance across financial services,
government, nonprofit, and consumer sectors. Led nine engineering teams, reduced release
cycles from six weeks to two days, cut annual operating costs by more than $500,000, and
improved organizational predictability and productivity. Combines executive leadership, enterprise
architecture, AI-enabled systems, and evidence-based decision practices to turn complex
technical environments into measurable business outcomes.
